final: WITH patient_groups AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS avg_alb_minus_tp FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt FROM patient_groups) SELECT g.SEX, AVG(g.avg_pt), AVG(g.avg_alb_minus_tp), AVG(g.avg_pt - o.avg_pt) FROM patient_groups AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_pt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY g.SEX ORDER BY g.SEX
